svg.text: Inference Metadata: One Contract, Many Generative Workflows
Executive architecture view — portable package facts define correctness; runtime policy chooses execution.
GENERATIVE WORKFLOWS: SHARED CONTRACT, DIFFERENT GRAPHS
All names, ports, shapes, state semantics and protocol family are declared once.
Runtime chooses queueing, fairness, capacity and placement; metadata only declares safe layouts/capacity.
DFlash conditions on target hidden outputs and owns draft state; it is not PLE and not target-KV sharing.
Prefix reuse is compatible runtime cache optimization — never the same thing.
Model-specific generator stages remain graph/package facts; the metadata vocabulary remains general.
Emit publishes to a declared workflow output (transport-neutral). Turn commit finalizes outputs; revision streams may close early with optional finalize.
No network/SSE/WebSocket transport is represented as metadata.
